resolutions.title: `git status --porcelain` refreshes `.git/index` as a side effect, an unnamed write inside an observe-only command
resolutions.evidence: Scratch repo: .git/index mtime moved across a git status --porcelain after touching a tracked file; the runner's env did not set GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS.
resolutions.action: The runner spawns every git and gh invocation with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; a case runs a whole select over a stale stat cache and asserts .git/index's bytes and mtime unchanged (fails on the pre-walk runner). The delta names the setting beside the PATH-lookup sentence.

introduced.text: Every invocation runs with `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`, so `status` refreshes no index.

final_assessment: Two of two resolved: ls-remote admits refs only in both allowlists, and every engine invocation runs with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 so status writes no index.
